from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687689/attempts/a19917c2b2c442ba9dde2ee9fd880e7d/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    """Extend the center row and column of every solid 3x3 color block.

    If extensions of different colors cross, leave the crossing cell blank.
    """
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    lines = {}
    for r in range(h - 2):
        for c in range(w - 2):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color != 0 and all(grid[rr][cc] == color
                                  for rr in range(r, r + 3)
                                  for cc in range(c, c + 3)):
                cr, cc = r + 1, c + 1
                # A solid block's center row and column are projected to the edges.
                for col in range(w):
                    lines.setdefault((cr, col), set()).add(color)
                for row in range(h):
                    lines.setdefault((row, cc), set()).add(color)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for (r, c), colors in lines.items():
        out[r][c] = next(iter(colors)) if len(colors) == 1 else 0
    return out
'''
p=base/'task-8f7af571.py'; p.write_text(source)
print(p)
